The longer it takes to vaccinate the world, the more variants we will see—and the longer this pandemic will go on.

The US must do more to ensure equitable access to vaccines, testing & treatment worldwide.

All people, regardless of race or ethnicity, must be treated humanely while fleeing conflict.

I'm calling on @EU_Commission to provide further info on how the EU is ensuring equitable refugee treatment. Read our letter @RepBeatty @RepGregoryMeeks @RepKarenBass @StaceyPlaskett👇🏾 https://t.co/cnYaAA9o2N

Abortion providers are heroes—the staff & volunteers who make abortions possible are essential to the health and well-being of patients across the country.

From the bottom of our hearts, thank you. #AbortionIsEssential

“The fight is never about grapes or lettuce. It is always about people.” - #CésarChávez

In honor of #CésarChávezDay, let’s remember that the legacy of his work was always for the people.

For the people and their fair wages.

For the people and their equal treatment.

Such a huge & historic win for the labor movement.
 
Anti-worker attacks by huge corporations like Amazon have driven union membership to an all-time low. Proud of these workers for fighting to exercise their right to organize, and I hope more follow.

Abortion patients are your neighbors, your friends, your colleagues, and, yes, even your elected officials. 

I shared my story alongside @RepJayapal @CoriBush @SenGaryPeters & @RepSpeier because lives are at stake. We must keep fighting.
https://t.co/BVpjmrqGpk

Join me live on Facebook TODAY at 1:00 PT / 4:00 ET for an important discussion on #Lupus research, treatment, and care, moderated by Rev. Cheryl Ward and featuring top experts in the field!

RSVP below👇🏾https://t.co/eZkrcQpoJV https://t.co/KvQVkdhOpV

Our next steps should include banning assault weapons, taking ghost guns off the streets, comprehensive background checks, promoting gun buy backs & more. 

We cannot stop until our schools, grocery stores, churches, hospitals, and all of our communities are safe.

Join me tonight for a live listening session on the hunger crisis with @fractweets, community food banks, & #CA13 constituents.

We'll discuss the hunger crisis' impact in the East Bay, federal nutrition programs, and the upcoming @WhiteHouse Conference on Hunger👇🏾 https://t.co/LnyfwpRjF1

Right now, seniors are just one devastating diagnosis away from paying tens of thousands of dollars for medicine they need to survive.
 
When this bill passes, no one 65 or older will need to pay more than $2,000 for prescription drugs a year. That is life-changing.👏🏾

Great news: @CDCgov has awarded more than $120 million to support the Ending the HIV Epidemic Initiative👏🏾

We must continue to support communities to expand these high-impact HIV diagnosis, treatment, prevention, & response strategies that are essential to end the HIV epidemic.

My thoughts are with all those without power in this vicious heat wave, including large swaths of the East Bay. I urge all Californians to practice heat safety—avoid being outdoors, stay hydrated, check on others, and seek medical attention for any heat-related symptoms.
Join me now at the introduction of my bill with @ChrisVanHollen @SenBooker @RepDannyDavis, the Sickle Cell Disease Treatment Centers Act ⬇️

Excited to be here at the first @WhiteHouse Conference on Hunger in over 50 years!

This is a prime opportunity for us to examine the root causes of hunger, proclaim structural racism as a barrier to access to nutrition, & identify solutions. #EndHunger https://t.co/wQaso2w1ch

Today is #WorldMentalHealthDay! As a clinical social worker by profession, I know the impact mental health care can make in peoples’ lives.

We must end stigma around mental health & ensure treatment for all, including people of color & the most vulnerable in the US & globally.

One third of Black Californians have experienced racism in health care—who knows how many have been misdiagnosed or received insufficient treatment.

We can't wait any longer for the federal government to actively develop anti-racist health policy.

At this point, it looks like Republicans’ idea of a “Commitment to America” is to slash critical programs millions have earned and rely on (i.e. Social Security and Medicare), and help the rich get richer instead 💰

Democrats, by contrast, are fighting to protect them.

Native women earn just 51 CENTS per dollar paid to white men in this country.
 
#EquityForNativeWomen requires equal pay AND an end to systemic violence, poverty & healthcare disparities, & much more. Only with an eye on full equity can we end racism-based economic injustice.

On the 34th annual #WorldAidsDay, we remember the millions lost to this deadly disease.
 
As Co-Chair of the Congressional HIV & AIDS Caucus, I’m dedicated to improving equity, access to medication & treatment, destigmatization, & achieving the first AIDS-free generation. https://t.co/Dgui3kQvoX

It is irresponsible & reckless to threaten to default on US debt to force the cutting of Social Security & Medicare, 2 of the most popular & successful govt programs in history. Let’s be clear: this is an attack on our most vulnerable communities.

This is low—even for the @GOP.

As we acknowledge International World Cancer Day, we must raise awareness and continue to encourage its prevention, detection, and treatment. Sending strength, love & prayers to those impacted by cancer. May we press forward to a cancer free future. #WorldCancerDay2023

Ahead of #SOTU, let’s be clear on the biggest threat to our economic progress: the @GOP.

Their economic plan?

—Cut Social Security & Medicare
—Raise taxes on working people w/a 30% national sales tax
—Worsen inflation & raise the deficit by letting rich tax cheats off the hook

Imagine trying to push a policy so unpopular that the only way you can think to get it done is by threatening to crash the entire economy.

That’s what Republicans are doing right now: threatening default for the first time in history in order to gut Social Security and Medicare.

The same politicians who passed billions and billions in tax cuts for the wealthy now say we have to cut nutrition support for families in need.

Give me a break. #DefendSNAP https://t.co/I1KEW1r9eN

Can food🥕🥬be medicine💊?

Join me & @SecBecerra @AlamedaHealth @ 9:45 AM PT for a roundtable on implementing the @WhiteHouse National Strategy on Hunger, Nutrition, and Health—& how we can build on Alameda’s food as medicine program on a national scale. https://t.co/poFBCsBYdC
